topic.title: Result propagation
topic.semantics: Prefix try unwraps Ok(T) or returns Err(E) from the enclosing function. Operand and output must each have exactly the payload cases Ok and Err with matching error types.
pitfalls: Runtime faults are not caught; postconditions still run

related.title: Variants
related.semantics: A nominal variant chooses one named case, optionally carrying a typed payload. Expected types can identify a case owner.
pitfalls: A case is not a record field
Bare payload-free cases need an identifying expected type

related.title: Typed permissions
related.semantics: Native and SQL libraries expose typed permission collections for capability restriction. Derived capabilities can remove rights. Launch grants bound root authority.
pitfalls: Permissions are authority, actions are behavior
Typed collections wrap a closed provider catalog; arbitrary FFI is absent
